fieldValues.title: In srs-web, a readable structure is invisible: sections open as search results, never as the document that explains them
fieldValues.summary: Opened in srs-web on 2026-10-30, four repositories built or fixed for readability (LiveWyer Insight, srs-context, srs-programme, muSrs on #408) all lose their reading path. A section opens as a search box, a type filter and a list of record cards: the overview written for it is never shown, the order is lost, and in srs-programme the Research section reads '68 records: domain 17, exercise 4, Notes 47'. The owner: "To be honest, I cannot understand them at all."
evidence: srs-programme opens on its first composition, which renders one heading and '1 info' (F2); the Research section shows 68 records grouped by type, not the introduction and seven threads
srs-context: 00 Brief opens as 15 record cards in search order; the 'How to read it' text written for each layer on 2026-10-30 appears nowhere
muSrs (#408): the front page document reads well, but uses labels such as STATEMENT: and TITLE:; the left column lists 20+ documents by machine name before the structure
LiveWyer Insight: the default document reads well; a section still opens as 5 cards with the anchor third
The documents list names compositions by machine name with their namespace (srs#928); the inspector column is empty until a record is clicked
Opening is fast (3 to 4.5 seconds) and shows no console errors: the problem is presentation, not loading
fieldValues.body: The data now carries what a reader needs: a guide in the identity record, an overview document anchoring each section, an ordered outline. The generic shell reads none of it: its structure view is discovery (find by containerId), and its first view is a composition picked by package order. Related: srs-web#668 (container pane ignores the outline), srs-web#425 (nav depth), srs#928 (composition titles), srs-rust#1490 (navigation order). The options for what srs-web should open on are an exercise.
